## Uploading Data Frames

```{r - Uploading data frames, echo=FALSE,include=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results="hide"}

PathToRProject <- "/Volumes/Data-1/Institute/Human_Ecology/cdebra/Work/OTProject.Chapter2/"

DF_Models <- read.csv(file.path(PathToRProject,
                                      "OTProject.Football.Models",

                                      "Data.Models.Football.csv"))
```

## Factorising variables

```{r - Factorising Variables}

DF_Models <- DF_Models %>%
  mutate(
    Breastfeeding.Method1 = round(as.numeric(Breastfeeding.Method1), 1) %>% as.factor(),
    SampleType = as.factor(SampleType),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    GameType = as.factor(GameType),
    Lot = as.factor(Lot),
    FieldWork = as.factor(FieldWork),
    Status = as.factor(Status),
  )

# Relevel the factors 
DF_Models <- DF_Models %>% 
  mutate(
    # SampleType
    SampleType = fct_relevel(
      SampleType,
      "BL", "Pre-Football", "Post-Football"
    ),
    # Sex : Reference = "F" (Women)
    Sex = relevel(
      Sex,                      
      ref = "F"
    ), 
    # GameType (Reference = TvT : Intracommunity) 
    GameType = fct_relevel(
      GameType,
      "TvT", "BetweenCommunities", "TvNT"
    )
  )
```

## Main Manuscript Models

### A) Model Competition

```{r - Model Competition with random slopes}

Formula.Model_RandomSlopesTeam <- bf(
  CorrectedOT | cens(OT.Censored) ~  
    Sex * SampleType + 
    Breastfeeding.Method1 +
    StandAge +
    FieldWork +
    Lot +
    # random effects
    (1 + SampleType | PID) +   
    (1 | TeamName) +           
    (1 | RIA) + 
    (1 | Extraction)
)

ModelCompetition_RandomSlopes_Teams <- brm( Formula.Model_RandomSlopesTeam,
  data    = DF_Models,
  family  = lognormal(),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  prior   = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd", group = "PID"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd", group = "TeamName"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd", group = "RIA"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd", group = "Extraction")
  )
)

summary(ModelCompetition_RandomSlopes_Teams)
pp_check(ModelCompetition_RandomSlopes_Teams, ndraws = 100)

```

### B) Model Group Salience

```{r - Model Group Salience with random slopes}

Formula.ModelGroupSalience_RandomSlopes_Teams <- bf(CorrectedOT | cens(OT.Censored) ~  
  Sex*SampleType*GameType +
  Breastfeeding.Method1 +
  StandAge +
  Lot +
  FieldWork +
    # random effects
    (1 + SampleType | PID) +   
    (1 | TeamName) +           
    (1 | RIA) + 
    (1 | Extraction)
)
  
  
Model.GroupSalience_RandomSlopes_Teams <- brm(
  formula = Formula.ModelGroupSalience_RandomSlopes_Teams,
  data = DF_Models,
  family = lognormal(),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd", group = "PID"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd", group = "TeamName"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd", group = "RIA"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd", group = "Extraction")
  )
)

summary(Model.GroupSalience_RandomSlopes_Teams)
pp_check(Model.GroupSalience_RandomSlopes_Teams, ndraws = 100)




```

### C) Model Physical Activity

```{r}

### MODEL PHYSICAL ACTIVITY 
Model.Football.PhysicalActivity <- brm(
  OT_PostFootball| cens(OT.Censored)  ~ StepsPerMinute * Sex +
                     OT_PreFootball +
                     Breastfeeding.Method1 +
                     StandAge +
                     Lot +
                    (1 | RIA) + (1 | Extraction) ,
  data    = DF.PhysicalActivity,
  family  = lognormal(), 
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b")
  )
)

summary(Model.Football.PhysicalActivity)
```

## Supplementary Materials Models

### A) Checking if Visitors have different baseline than locals

```{r}

# Keeping Pre-Football Samples 
Data.PreFootball <- DF_Models %>%
  filter(SampleType == "Pre-Football")

# Supplementary Model 1 - Formula 
Formula.PreFootball <- bf(
  CorrectedOT | cens(OT.Censored) ~ 
    Sex * Status * GameType  +  
    Breastfeeding.Method1 +
    StandAge +
    Lot +
    FieldWork +
    (1 | RIA) + (1 | Extraction) + (1 | PID)
)

# Supplementary Model 1 
Supplementary_Model1 <- brm(
  formula = Formula.PreFootball,
  data = Data.PreFootball,
  family = lognormal(),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth = 15),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd", group = "PID"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd", group = "RIA"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd", group = "Extraction")
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 6000, warmup = 2000, cores = 4
)
summary(Supplementary_Model1)

```

```{r - Figure 1 }
# Compute posteriors for men and women
Function.ComputePosteriors <- function(Intercept, EffectMen = 0, EffectPostFoot = 0, InteractionMenPostFoot = 0) {
  pre_foot <- Intercept + EffectMen
  post_foot <- Intercept + EffectMen + EffectPostFoot + InteractionMenPostFoot
  effect <- post_foot - pre_foot
  return(data.frame(FootballEffect = effect))
}

# Extract coefficients
Intercept <- ModelCompetition_Posteriors$b_Intercept
EffectMen <- ModelCompetition_Posteriors$b_SexM
EffectPostFoot <- ModelCompetition_Posteriors$b_SampleTypePostMFootball
InteractionMenPostFoot <- ModelCompetition_Posteriors$`b_SexM:SampleTypePostMFootball`

# Compute effects for men and women
Model_CompetitionEffect.Men <- Function.ComputePosteriors(Intercept, EffectMen, EffectPostFoot, InteractionMenPostFoot)
Model_CompetitionEffect.Women <- Function.ComputePosteriors(Intercept, 0, EffectPostFoot, 0)

# Compute positive posteriors
Function.ComputePositivePosteriors <- function(effect_df, threshold = 0) {
  return(round(sum(effect_df$FootballEffect > threshold) / nrow(effect_df), 2))
}

# Positive posteriors for men
PositivePosteriors.Men <- Function.ComputePositivePosteriors(Model_CompetitionEffect.Men)
# Positive posteriors for women
PositivePosteriors.Women <- Function.ComputePositivePosteriors(Model_CompetitionEffect.Women)

# Function to  add the Group column
Function.RenameAndLabel <- function(DF, GroupName) {
  DF <- DF %>%
    mutate(Group = GroupName)
  return(DF)
}

Model_CompetitionEffect.Men <- Function.RenameAndLabel(Model_CompetitionEffect.Men, "Men")
Model_CompetitionEffect.Women <- Function.RenameAndLabel(Model_CompetitionEffect.Women, "Women")

# Combine both datasets (Model_CompetitionEffect.Men + Model_CompetitionEffect.Women -> CombinedEffect)
CombinedEffect <- bind_rows(Model_CompetitionEffect.Men, Model_CompetitionEffect.Women)

# Function to compute density and extract the maximum density value
Function.ComputeDensity <- function(DF) {
  DensityData <- density(DF$FootballEffect)
  return(list(
    max_effect = DensityData$x[which.max(DensityData$y)],
    max_density = max(DensityData$y)
  ))
}

# Compute density values for men and women

DensityWomen <- Function.ComputeDensity(Model_CompetitionEffect.Women)

# 1. Calculate density by group (Men and Women)
DensityData_ModelCompetition <- CombinedEffect %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  do({
    d <- density(.$FootballEffect, na.rm = TRUE)
    data.frame(
      EffectValue   = d$x,   #
      EffectDensity = d$y,   
      Group         = unique(.$Group)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(PosNeg = ifelse(EffectValue < 0, "Negative", "Positive"))


# 2. Make the Figure 1.A
MakeFigure1A <- function(density_df,
                         x_label = "Effect of Football competition on Oxytocin",
                         y_label = "Density",
                         group_colors = c("#007649", "#593987"),
                         neg_fill = "grey70",
                         alpha_fill = 0.6,
                         line_size = 0.4,
                         vline_linetype = "dotted",
                         legend_position = c(1.3, 0.8)) {
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_line(
      data = density_df,
      aes(x = EffectValue, y = EffectDensity, group = Group),
      size = line_size, color = "black"
    ) +
    
    # <0 in grey
    geom_ribbon(
      data = dplyr::filter(density_df, PosNeg == "Negative"),
      aes(x = EffectValue, ymin = 0, ymax = EffectDensity, group = Group),
      fill = neg_fill, alpha = alpha_fill
    ) +
    
    # >0 coloured by group
    geom_ribbon(
      data = dplyr::filter(density_df, PosNeg == "Positive"),
      aes(x = EffectValue, ymin = 0, ymax = EffectDensity, fill = Group, group = Group),
      alpha = alpha_fill
    ) +
    
    # vertical line in 0
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = vline_linetype, color = "black") +
    
    labs(
      title = "",
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = group_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 3))
    ) +
    
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "azure4", size = 0.05),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "azure4", size = 0.05),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = legend_position,
      legend.key = element_blank()
    )
}

Figure1.A <- MakeFigure1A(DensityData_ModelCompetition)
```

```{r - Figure 2 }
    # Scenarios POST
    # LEVEL 1 - MEN
      Men.Post.Level1 =

      b_SexM +
      b_SampleTypePostMFootball+

      `b_SampleTypePostMFootball:GameTypeBetweenCommunities` +

# Positive proportions
Vars <- c(
  "Men.CompetitionEffect.Level1", "Women.CompetitionEffect.Level1",
  "Men.CompetitionEffect.Level2", "Men.CompetitionEffect.Level3"
)
# Define a function to calculate the proportion of posterior samples greater than 0
Prop.Positive <- function(x) mean(x > 0)
# Apply the function to each variable in Vars using the post-scenario dataset
# This computes, for each effect, the probability that the effect is strictly positive
Positive.Props <- sapply(Vars, function(v) Prop.Positive(Posteriors.GroupSalience.Scenarios[[v]]))
# Round the results to 2 decimal places
Positive.Props <- round(Positive.Props, 2)
# Convert the named vector to a list for easier formatting and access later
Positive.Props <- as.list(Positive.Props)

# 4. Limit x axis
xlims <- range(Posteriors.GroupSalience.Scenarios[, Vars])

# 5. Function to generate density plots with PP shown in legend
create_density_plot <- function(data, var_names, colors, labels, title, xlims, pp_vals) {

  # Reshape data to long format
  df <- data %>%
    select(all_of(var_names)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Group", values_to = "Effect") %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = var_names))

  # Extract density data from base plot
  base_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Effect, fill = Group)) + geom_density(size = 1)
  dens_data <- ggplot_build(base_plot)$data[[1]]

  # Assign group names and classify values as positive or negative
  dens_data <- dens_data %>%
    mutate(
      Group = factor(rep(var_names, each = nrow(dens_data) / length(var_names))),
      PosNeg = ifelse(x > 0, "Positive", "Negative")
    )

  # Create dynamic labels for the legend with PP values included
  legend_labels <- sapply(seq_along(var_names), function(i) {
    sprintf("%s Post-Competition ; P(> 0) = %.2f", labels[i], pp_vals[[var_names[i]]])
  })

  # Final plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(data = dens_data, aes(x = x, y = y, group = Group), size = 0.5, color = "black") +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = filter(dens_data, PosNeg == "Negative"),
      aes(x = x, ymin = 0, ymax = y, group = Group),
      fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = filter(dens_data, PosNeg == "Positive"),
      aes(x = x, ymin = 0, ymax = y, fill = Group, group = Group),
      alpha = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    xlim(xlims) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Effect of Football Competition",
      y = "Density",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(colors, var_names), labels = legend_labels) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
  
  return(p)
}

# 6. Generate plots for each level
P.Level1 <- create_density_plot(
  Posteriors.GroupSalience.Scenarios,
  var_names = c("Men.CompetitionEffect.Level1", "Women.CompetitionEffect.Level1"),
  colors = c("#007649", "#593987"),
  labels = c("Men", "Women"),
  title = "Intra-Community",
  xlims = xlims,
  pp_vals = Positive.Props
)

P.Level2 <- create_density_plot(
  Posteriors.GroupSalience.Scenarios,
  var_names = c("Men.CompetitionEffect.Level2"),
  colors = c("#007649"),
  labels = c("Men"),
  title = "Inter-Community",
  xlims = xlims,
  pp_vals = Positive.Props
)

P.Level3 <- create_density_plot(
  Posteriors.GroupSalience.Scenarios,
  var_names = c("Men.CompetitionEffect.Level3"),
  colors = c("#007649"),
  labels = c("Men"),
  title = "Tsimane' VS Non-Tsimane'",
  xlims = xlims,
  pp_vals = Positive.Props
)

# 7. Combine plots
Plot.Posteriors.GroupSalience <- P.Level1 / P.Level2 / P.Level3 +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98)
    )
  )
```

```{r}


# Getting posteriors 
Posteriors.Model0.Football.PhysicalActivity <- posterior_samples(Model.Football.PhysicalActivity)

# Creating a dataframe with sex effect
EffectsDF <- tibble(
  Sex = rep(c("Female", "Male"), each = nrow(Posteriors.Model0.Football.PhysicalActivity)),
  Effect = c(
    Posteriors.Model0.Football.PhysicalActivity$b_StepsPerMinute,
    Posteriors.Model0.Football.PhysicalActivity$b_StepsPerMinute +
      Posteriors.Model0.Football.PhysicalActivity$`b_StepsPerMinute:SexM`
  )
)

# Define x-axis limits
xlims <- range(EffectsDF$Effect)

# Compute the proportion of values > 0 for each sex
PP.Women.StepsPerMinute <- mean(EffectsDF$Effect[EffectsDF$Sex == "Female"] > 0) # Calculate the proportion of posterior samples for females where the effect is greater than 0
PP.Men.StepsPerMinute <- mean(EffectsDF$Effect[EffectsDF$Sex == "Male"] > 0) # Calculate the proportion of posterior samples for males where the effect is greater than 0


# Graph
# Ensure the order of Sex levels (important for consistent group mapping)
EffectsDF$Sex <- factor(EffectsDF$Sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))

# Create a temporary plot to extract density data
base_plot <- ggplot(EffectsDF, aes(x = Effect, color = Sex, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_density(size = 1)

# Extract density data from the built ggplot object
dens_data <- ggplot_build(base_plot)$data[[1]]

# Manually associate group numbers with Sex and flag values above/below zero
dens_data <- dens_data %>%
  mutate(
    Sex = ifelse(group == 1, "Female", "Male"),
    PosNeg = ifelse(x > 0, "Positive", "Negative")
  )

# Compute the proportion of posterior samples > 0 for each sex
PP.Women.StepsPerMinute <- mean(EffectsDF$Effect[EffectsDF$Sex == "Female"] > 0)
PP.Men.StepsPerMinute <- mean(EffectsDF$Effect[EffectsDF$Sex == "Male"] > 0)

# Final plot
PhysicalActivity.PosteriorDistribution.Plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = dens_data, aes(x = x, y = y, group = Sex), size = 1, color = "black") +

  # Gray area under the curve for values ≤ 0
  geom_ribbon(
    data = filter(dens_data, PosNeg == "Negative"),
    aes(x = x, ymin = 0, ymax = y, group = Sex),
    fill = "grey70",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # Colored area under the curve for values > 0
  geom_ribbon(
    data = filter(dens_data, PosNeg == "Positive"),
    aes(x = x, ymin = 0, ymax = y, fill = Sex, group = Sex),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  xlim(xlims) +
  labs(
    x = "Effect of Physical Activity (Steps per minute)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Female" = "#593987", "Male" = "#007649"),
    labels = c(
      "Female" = paste0("Women (PP = ", round(PP.Women.StepsPerMinute, 2), ")"),
      "Male" = paste0("Men (PP = ", round(PP.Men.StepsPerMinute, 2),")")
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),  # Remove title
    plot.title.position = "panel",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

# Display the plot
PhysicalActivity.PosteriorDistribution.Plot



# Extract conditional effects from the fitted Bayesian model
ConditionalEffectsOutput <- conditional_effects(Model.Football.PhysicalActivity, plot = FALSE)

# Extract the specific conditional effect of StepsPerMinute by Sex
EffectData <- ConditionalEffectsOutput[["StepsPerMinute:Sex"]]

# Recode the Sex variable: F -> Women, M -> Men
# Also reorder levels so that Women appears first (on top in the legend)
EffectData$Sex <- factor(EffectData$Sex, levels = c("F", "M"), labels = c("Women", "Men"))

# Generate the plot with custom colors and updated legend labels
ConditionalEffect.PhysicalActivity <- ggplot(EffectData, aes(x = StepsPerMinute, y = estimate__, color = Sex, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +  # Plot the conditional effect lines
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +  # Add 95% credible intervals

  # Define custom colors for the lines and shaded ribbons
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Women" = "#593987", "Men" = "#007649")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Women" = "#593987", "Men" = "#007649")) +

  # Set axis labels and legend titles
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Physical Activity (Steps per minute)",
    y = "% Change in Corrected Oxytocin Concentration",
    color = "Sex",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +

  # Apply a clean minimal theme and customize text appearance
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )


# Display the plot
ConditionalEffect.PhysicalActivity

pA <- PhysicalActivity.PosteriorDistribution.Plot
pB <- ConditionalEffect.PhysicalActivity

plot_grid(pA, pB, labels = c("A", "B"), nrow = 1, align = "hv")
```

```{r Supplementary Figure 1}
# Posteriors extraction 
Supplementary1_Posteriors <- Supplementary_Model1 %>%
  spread_draws(
    b_Intercept,
    `b_SexM`, 
    `b_StatusVisitors`, 
    `b_GameTypeTvNT`, 
    `b_GameTypeBetweenCommunities`,
    `b_SexM:StatusVisitors`,
    `b_SexM:GameTypeTvNT`,
    `b_SexM:GameTypeBetweenCommunities`,
    `b_StatusVisitors:GameTypeTvNT`,
    `b_StatusVisitors:GameTypeBetweenCommunities`,
    `b_SexM:StatusVisitors:GameTypeTvNT`,
    `b_SexM:StatusVisitors:GameTypeBetweenCommunities`
  )
# 
Supplementary1_PosteriorConditions <- Supplementary1_Posteriors %>%
  mutate(
    `Men Locals Intracommunity` = b_Intercept,
    
    `Men Locals TvNT` = b_Intercept + b_GameTypeTvNT + `b_SexM:GameTypeTvNT`,
    
    `Men Visitors TvNT` = b_Intercept + 
      `b_SexM` + `b_StatusVisitors` + b_GameTypeTvNT +
      `b_SexM:StatusVisitors` + `b_SexM:GameTypeTvNT` + 
      `b_StatusVisitors:GameTypeTvNT` + `b_SexM:StatusVisitors:GameTypeTvNT`,
    
    `Men Visitors Between Community` = b_Intercept + 
      `b_SexM` + `b_StatusVisitors` + b_GameTypeBetweenCommunities +
      `b_SexM:StatusVisitors` + `b_SexM:GameTypeBetweenCommunities` + 
      `b_StatusVisitors:GameTypeBetweenCommunities` + `b_SexM:StatusVisitors:GameTypeBetweenCommunities`
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Men Locals Intracommunity`,
    `Men Locals TvNT`,
    `Men Visitors TvNT`,
    `Men Visitors Between Community`
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Condition", values_to = "Estimate")


#########  FIGURE SUPPLEMENTARY MATERIALS  ######### 

# Levels
lvls <- c(
  "Pre-Football (Men - Locals) Intra-Community",
  "Pre-Football (Men - Locals) Tsimane' VS Non-Tsimane'",
  "Pre-Football (Men - Visitors) Tsimane' VS Non-Tsimane'",
  "Pre-Football (Men - Visitors) Inter-Community"
)

Supplementary_Figure1 <- Supplementary1_PosteriorConditions %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean  = mean(Estimate),
    Lower = quantile(Estimate, 0.025),
    Upper = quantile(Estimate, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Group
    Group = ifelse(grepl("Visitors", Condition), "Visitors", "Locals"),
    # Rename
    Condition = recode(Condition,
      "Men Locals Intracommunity" = "Pre-Football (Men - Locals) Intra-Community",
            "Men Visitors Between Community" = "Pre-Football (Men - Visitors) Inter-Community",
      "Men Locals TvNT" = "Pre-Football (Men - Locals) Tsimane' VS Non-Tsimane'",
      "Men Visitors TvNT" = "Pre-Football (Men - Visitors) Tsimane' VS Non-Tsimane'"
    ),
    # Order conditions 
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = lvls)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Condition, y = Mean, color = Group)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), linewidth = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Forest Plot of Posterior Effects",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Estimated Effect (log-scale)",
    color = "Group"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Locals" = "cadetblue", "Visitors" = "burlywood4")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
